interpretation: The experiment isolates routing and noninterference as solved: every route was correct and all ten strong capabilities were byte-identical to V463. Ordinary teacher-forced token loss on a frozen parent supplied almost no useful held-out corrective signal: initial loss was already 0.000445 while the four target development surfaces did not improve. The residual family is closed without a nearby sweep.
decision: Preserve V466 as negative evidence. Audit acquisition-to-development support and teacher-forced versus autonomous exposure on the four weak capability families before selecting a different mechanism. Do not vary the residual rank, rate, steps, seed, loss weight, or route scope.
claim_boundary: Development-only negative evidence plus exact routing/noninterference evidence; no promotion, runtime, Phase 3, or superiority claim.
